Class LogEncoder.Buffer.StringBuilderBuffer

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder.Buffer.StringBuilderBuffer
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogEncoder.Buffer, AutoCloseable
Enclosing interface:
LogEncoder.Buffer
public static final class LogEncoder.Buffer.StringBuilderBuffer extends Object implements LogEncoder.Buffer
A buffer that simply wraps a StringBuilder. Direct access to the StringBuilder is available as the field stringBuilder.

    LogEncoder.Buffer.DirectByteBufferBuffer
    A buffer that formats into a reused StringBuilder (like LogEncoder.Buffer.StringBuilderBuffer) but encodes directly into a reused ByteBuffer via a CharsetEncoder, instead of going through an intermediate String and byte[] the way LogOutput.write(LogEvent, String)'s default implementation does.
